purpose: Compare inventory-triggered baseline/candidate actions with whole-controller blocks and two expanded-library designs
protocol_type: Internal prospective record fixed before new simulation outcomes
threshold_rule: Preservation one when inventory >= s, zero below; block-start projected parameter estimate selects s from the same 16 by 27 grid, solving stationary intervention rate = 0.9B analytically

common.certificate: existing fixed-prior Gaussian mixture and full rectangle class covers

analysis.primary_family: Six two-sided Welch comparisons: threshold versus each of AB, D-optimal and policy-directed, at both primary truths; Holm adjustment across six
analysis.ratio_intervals: 20000 independent bootstrap resamples; pointwise descriptive 95% intervals
